key_insight: Solvent-exposed vitrimer networks begin losing connectivity below the critical dissolution temperature and form smaller network fragments rather than fully separating into individual polymer chains.
engineering_relevance: These findings could guide solvent-assisted vitrimer recycling by linking temperature and crosslink concentration to network fragmentation.
method: Analysis of network fragmentation and dynamic bond redistribution
evidence_signal: Simulations show that the critical dissolution temperature rises nonlinearly with crosslink concentration, while intrachain dynamic bonds increase with temperature.
watch_item: The abstract reports simulation results without experimental validation, so transferability to practical recycling conditions remains uncertain.
paper_title: Solvent-Mediated Disintegration of a Vitrimer Network
